scope: Runtime asset subset for the first playable build. Source archives stay in gitignored assets/source-packs/.

sources.name: Rasak Modern Tilesets
sources.purpose: Optional alternative visual system (48x48 modern city tiles)
sources.downloadMethod: itch.io 'Name Your Own Price' flow (manual, requires browser purchase/download step)
sources.license: page-text-only; bundle LICENSE/README not verified (not downloaded)
sources.notes: Re-checked official page on 2026-11-01: page loads (HTTP 200), but download still requires the manual itch.io purchase/Name-Your-Own-Price flow. No archive, tile image, screenshot, or derived asset is retained in this repository. Package-level license/spec/views cannot be verified until a human obtains the .rar.
manualSteps: 3. On the 'Name your own price' screen enter 0 (or pay voluntarily), then continue.
4. Complete the itch.io flow (login/email as prompted) and download the archive.
6. Keep every bundled LICENSE / README / credits file untouched next to the tiles.
7. Manually confirm the real tile specification (claimed 48x48) by reading the pack README and measuring a sample tile; do not trust the claim alone.
8. Only after license + spec are confirmed, add entries to assets/manifests/asset-catalog.json and copy an approved subset into public/assets/.
9. Do not publish the original Rasak images to a public repository without permission from the author.

officialPageObservation.description: over 40 modern tilesets; commercial/non-commercial use and editing allowed with credit to Rasak

viewAssessment.projection: top-down / 3/4 front-facing RPG Maker-style buildings; not diamond isometric
viewAssessment.compatibility: Requires full tileset/map-scale replacement; not compatible with current 16x16 Kenney tile grid or its 44x32 layout without re-authoring.
viewAssessment.recommendation: If adopted, use ordinary oblique (斜俯视) orthogonal projection, not diamond isometric. Do not mix with Kenney in the same city scene. Decision deferred; no map rework in this fix.
